resources.string: Enter the address of the computer running the RipenSense AI Flask server (e.g. http://192.168.1.42:5000) to get started.
Run \'python app/app.py\' on your computer, then find its local IP address (Wi-Fi settings, or \'ipconfig\'/\'ifconfig\'). Your phone and that computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
Camera permission was denied — the \'Scan with Camera\' tab won\'t work until you allow it in Android Settings › Apps › RipenSense AI › Permissions.
Couldn\'t reach the server at this address. Check that the Flask app is running and that your phone is on the same Wi-Fi network, then tap Reload.
